messages:
alex: vendor just flagged a tranche of A100s in eu-west1 as 'on hold' pending invoice reconciliation. this might touch the demo pool for tomorrow, can someone confirm impact?
priya: which tranche/po? do we have PO# or invoice id?
josh: PO# 84621-RED. pinged vendor contact (cc @ivan). waiting on their AP team to clear.
ivan: FYI vendor says hold is for invoices dated before 2026-02-10, they're doing a batch audit. they said ~2-4hrs for AP once we resubmit receipts.
alex: ok so potentially a short window. can we route demo traffic to standby h100 pool if needed?
katie: we have automatic fallback policy but demo route pinned to eu-west1-a100. I can unpin and add runtime fallback to eu-west1-h100 for the night. want me to flip it? :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
priya: +1 to katie flipping. also we should confirm any quota differences — h100 has different per-tenant limits.
josh: quick check: run `gcloud compute accelerator-types list --zones=eu-west1-*` and confirm availability/quotas.
ivan: ran a quick quota query, looks like tenant quota available for h100 but ephemeral. I'll attach the command we used:
```
# quota check snippet
gcloud compute regions describe europe-west1 --format=json | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS_ALL_REGIONS")'
```
ivan: vendor-bot: invoice 4621 processed?
vendor-bot: invoice 4621 status: pending_review -> reconciled at 2026-03-15T09:12Z. funds clear in vendor ledger. (automated update)
alex: nice. repo of receipts updated?
josh: PR #4523 added revised receipts to billing bucket. finance to confirm.
katie: i'll prepare the temporary route change and a canary: 10% to h100 for 30m, then back if stable. will post the rollout plan in the console.
priya: noted — also flagging this for @oncall for potential SLA brief. not urgent but want visibility.
ivan: if vendor hold recurs we should ask for a grace window in contract; i'll draft a short note for vendor ops.
alex: thanks all. action items: (1) katie toggle canary, (2) josh/ivan confirm quota edge cases, (3) priya follow-up with finance, (4) if hold returns escalate to vendor ops. back in 45m for status. :thumbsup:
